messages:
Maya: ok team — hot take: we need an Official Desk LLM Mascot. short list: Cachecat, Kv-Koala, TokenTom, Quant-Quokka. vote with emoji! :cat: :koala: :chipmunk: :quokka:
Sam: TokenTom for the win. he autocompletes my lunch orders and leaves sticky system prompts on my monitor. :joy:
Devon: Cachecat will silently hoard prefixes and act like its a caching strategy. 100% sabotage. :cat_with_wry_smile:
Jen: can we also have a mascot crest that says: "Committed to low-latency cuddles"? i drew a terrible sketch, will share if TokenTom wins. :art:
Alex: formalizing this sounds dangerous but also necessary. propose we add a slack emoji :token_tom: and a tiny repo: `redwood/desk-mascots` for merch ideas.
Kris: if TokenTom becomes official, rename the token metric to "TomScore" and require a 3:1 Tom to human ratio in PR reviews.
ops-bot: poll created: "Pick the Official Desk LLM Mascot" — options: Cachecat, Kv-Koala, TokenTom, Quant-Quokka. 10 votes so far.
pollbot: poll results: TokenTom 6, Cachecat 2, Kv-Koala 1, Quant-Quokka 1. (react with :tada: to finalize)
Maya: my pitch for TokenTom: whisper-level autocomplete, naps in the KV cache, and only eats stopwords.
Sam: low-key want a model persona prompt we can drop into demos: ```system: You are TokenTom, a polite model who answers like a caffeine-deprived librarian. persona: gentle, slightly sarcastic, loves lists.```
Devon: idea: office ritual — anyone who gets a latency spike must buy TokenTom stickers for the team.
Jen: can we have an emoji vote reenactment? someone GIF TokenTom doing a dignified stretch. :gif:
Alex: scheduled a 5-min "mascot coronation" in #random at 3pm — bring sticker designs.
Kris: :thumbsup: also, may we legally trademark "TokenTom"? asking for a friend. :sweat_smile:
Maya: closing thoughts: this thread has convinced me that our infra is emotionally prepared for a mascot. long live TokenTom. :crown:
